about: Bootloaders the Rockchip boards page writes to a Lyra's onboard SPI NAND (irate_box/root/rkboard.py). The files are not shipped: stage them in <state>/rk-bootloaders/<id>/ with a SHA256SUMS beside them. The offsets are the tested RK3506 NAND layout: idbloader.img at 0 and 4 MiB, u-boot.itb at 8 MiB.

source.nand-uboot: Kwiboo c6782a3 plus the SPI-NAND SPL patches (05/15 and 06/15), built 2026-11-01
source.stock: the bootloader Luckfox ships with the Lyra Zero W

bootloaders.title: Original bootloader
bootloaders.summary: The bootloader Luckfox ships with the Lyra Zero W. Its files are not in irate-box: put them in rk-bootloaders/stock with their SHA256SUMS.

bootloaders.title: irate-box NAND U-Boot
bootloaders.summary: The U-Boot built 2026-11-01 whose SPL loads U-Boot proper from the SPI NAND. Its checksums are shipped, so a staged copy is checked before it is written.
